description: This file contains helper functions for a documentation chatbot, including utilities for indexing, filtering, deduplicating, citation building, formatting, and document aggregation related to retrieval results.

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Represents a citation with metadata such as key, path, line range, section, preview, and score.

classes.name: DocumentContext
classes.description: Contains information about a document, including key, full text, path, matching chunks, relevance score, and sections.

classes.name: RetrievalResult
classes.description: Represents a search retrieval result with source, text, score, and metadata.

methods.name: alpha_key
methods.description: Converts a non-negative integer index to an alphabetic string key (e.g., 0->A, 1->B, ..., 26->AA).

methods.name: filter_hits
methods.description: Filters search hits by namespace and minimum score.

methods.name: deduplicate_results
methods.description: Removes duplicate retrieval results based on source, keeping the highest scoring result per source.

methods.name: build_citations
methods.description: Creates citation objects from retrieval results, extracting source info and lines.

methods.name: format_context_for_synthesis
methods.description: Formats retrieval results into a string suitable for AI prompt context.

methods.name: calculate_document_score
methods.description: Calculates a relevance score for a set of chunks, considering scores and coverage.

methods.name: aggregate_chunks_to_documents
methods.description: Groups chunks by document, fetches full documents, and ranks them by relevance.

methods.name: format_documents_for_synthesis
methods.description: Formats full document texts with minimal metadata for AI comprehension.

methods.name: build_citations_from_documents
methods.description: Converts document contexts into citation objects.
